title: Schema.org Drug
description: A chemical or biologic substance, used as a medical therapy, that has a physiological effect on an organism.

url.description: URL with information about the drug.

alternateName.description: An alias for the drug (e.g., brand names, generic names).

nonProprietaryName.description: The generic name of this drug or supplement.

proprietaryName.description: The proprietary name of this drug.

activeIngredient.description: An active ingredient, typically chemical compounds and/or biologic substances.

drugClass.description: The class of drug this belongs to.

administrationRoute.description: A route by which this drug may be administered (e.g., oral, intravenous, topical).

dosageForm.description: A dosage form in which this drug/supplement is available (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection).

doseSchedule.description: A dosing schedule for the drug.

maximumIntake.description: Recommended intake of this supplement for a given population.

mechanismOfAction.description: The specific biochemical interaction through which this drug or supplement produces its pharmacological effect.

interactingDrug.description: Another drug that is known to interact with this drug.

foodWarning.description: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to consumption of specific foods.

alcoholWarning.description: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to consumption of alcohol.

pregnancyWarning.description: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to this drug's use during pregnancy.

breastfeedingWarning.description: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to this drug's use by breastfeeding mothers.

warning.description: Any FDA or other warnings about the drug.

overdosage.description: Any information related to overdose on a drug.

clinicalPharmacology.description: Description of the absorption and elimination of drugs.

availableStrength.description: An available dosage strength for the drug.

isProprietary.description: True if this item's name is a proprietary/brand name.

isAvailableGenerically.description: True if the drug is available in a generic form.

prescriptionStatus.description: Indicates whether this drug is available by prescription or over-the-counter.

legalStatus.description: The drug or supplement's legal status.

code.description: A medical code for the drug.

sameAs.description: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity.

DoseSchedule.description: A specific dosing schedule for a drug or supplement.

doseUnit.description: The unit of the dose (e.g., mg).

frequency.description: How often the dose is taken.

targetPopulation.description: Characteristics of the population for which this is intended.

MaximumDoseSchedule.description: The maximum dosing schedule considered safe.

DrugStrength.description: A specific strength in which a medical drug is available.
